metadata.title: Water Supply Department & Infrastructure Facilities in Pune
metadata.description: Comprehensive dataset of geographical coordinates, purification capacities, supply zones, operational roles, and contact information for the Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) Water Supply Department, major Water Treatment Plants (WTPs), raw water pumping stations, master balancing reservoirs (MBRs), zonal division offices, PCMC water works, and Maharashtra Jeevan Pradhikaran (MJP).

administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.name: PMC Water Supply Department Central Head Office
administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.role_and_responsibilities: Citywide water governance, planning and execution of 24x7 Equitable Water Supply Scheme, new tap connections, water meters, pipeline laying, and monitoring of water quality.
administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.address: Second Floor, Sawarkar Bhavan, Congress House Road, Shivajinagar

administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.name: PCMC Water Supply Department Headquarters
administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.role_and_responsibilities: Management of raw water lifting from Pavana Dam and Andra Dam, operation of Nigdi WTP, water distribution grid, and AMRUT water supply schemes across Pimpri-Chinchwad.
administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.address: PCMC Main Administrative Building, Mumbai - Pune Road, Pimpri Colony

administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.name: Maharashtra Jeevan Pradhikaran (MJP) - Pune Divisional Office
administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.governing_body: Water Supply & Sanitation Department, Government of Maharashtra
administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.role_and_responsibilities: Apex state agency responsible for designing, executing, and technical sanctioning of regional rural and peri-urban water supply schemes, bulk water pipelines, and quality monitoring in Pune district.
administrative_headquarters_and_regulato.address: Central Building, 5, Finance Road, Agarkar Nagar, Pune Station

major_water_treatment_plants.name: Parvati Water Treatment Plant (Old & New Jalkendra)
major_water_treatment_plants.source_dam: Khadakwasla Dam (via closed conduit & canal pipeline)
major_water_treatment_plants.supply_zones: Old City Peth areas, Swargate, Sahakarnagar, Parvati, Bibwewadi, Dhankawadi, Katraj, Camp (West), and Deccan Gymkhana
major_water_treatment_plants.address: 123, Deshpande Chowk, Narveer Tanaji Malusare Road (Sinhgad Road), Parvati Foothills

major_water_treatment_plants.name: Warje Water Treatment Plant (100 MLD & 200 MLD Units)
major_water_treatment_plants.supply_zones: Kothrud, Warje, Karvenagar, Bavdhan, Baner, Balewadi, Pashan, Shivane, and NDA Road
major_water_treatment_plants.address: Brahma Chaitanya Society, Hingane Home Colony, Warje Jakat Naka, Warje

major_water_treatment_plants.name: Pune Cantonment / Lashkar Water Works (Jalkendra)
major_water_treatment_plants.source_dam: Khadakwasla Dam canal & Mutha Right Bank canal
major_water_treatment_plants.supply_zones: Pune Cantonment (Camp), Koregaon Park, Dhole Patil Road, Hadapsar, Wanowrie, Fatima Nagar, Kondhwa, and Ramtekdi
major_water_treatment_plants.address: 5-B, General Bhagat Marg, Near Bund Garden / MJP Colony, Camp

major_water_treatment_plants.name: Vadgaon Budruk Water Treatment Plant
major_water_treatment_plants.supply_zones: Vadgaon Budruk, Dhayari, Ambegaon Budruk & Khurd, Narhe, Sinhgad Road corridor, and Katraj-Kondhwa Bypass
major_water_treatment_plants.address: Near Sinhgad Institute Campus, Vadgaon Budruk, Sinhgad Road

major_water_treatment_plants.name: Holkar Water Works (Khadki Water Treatment Plant)
major_water_treatment_plants.facility_type: Urban Water Treatment Plant & Pumping Station
major_water_treatment_plants.source_dam: Mula River & Khadakwasla raw water feeder
major_water_treatment_plants.supply_zones: Khadki Cantonment, Bopodi, Aundh (East), Range Hills, and Vishrantwadi
major_water_treatment_plants.address: Near Holkar Bridge, Mula River Bank, Khadki

major_water_treatment_plants.name: Bhama Askhed Water Supply Project - Terminal WTP & Pumping Station
major_water_treatment_plants.facility_type: Mega Regional Water Treatment Plant & Distribution Grid
major_water_treatment_plants.supply_zones: Kharadi, Vadgaon Sheri, Viman Nagar, Kalyani Nagar, Lohagaon, Tingre Nagar, Dhanori, and Ahmednagar Road corridor
major_water_treatment_plants.address: Terminal Distribution Grid, Kharadi - Vadgaon Sheri Riverfront

major_water_treatment_plants.name: PCMC Water Treatment Plant (Nigdi Sector 23)
major_water_treatment_plants.facility_type: PCMC Apex Central Water Purification Complex
major_water_treatment_plants.source_dam: Pavana Dam (via Ravet bund & raw water pumping station)
major_water_treatment_plants.supply_zones: Entire Pimpri-Chinchwad municipal area: Nigdi, Akurdi, Chinchwad, Pimpri, Bhosari, Moshi, Sangvi, Wakad, Rahatani, and Ravet
major_water_treatment_plants.address: Sector Number 23, Transport Nagar, Pradhikaran, Nigdi

major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.name: Khadakwasla Dam Raw Water Pumping Station & Jackwell
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.facility_type: Raw Water Intake & High-Pressure Pumping Station
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.function: Primary raw water intake point lifting impounded river water from Khadakwasla reservoir into closed conduits and gravity canals feeding Parvati, Warje, and Vadgaon WTPs.
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.address: Khadakwasla Dam Foot, Sinhgad Road, Khadakwasla

major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.name: SNDT Water Works & Booster Pumping Station
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.facility_type: Intermediate Booster Pumping Station & Service Reservoir
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.function: Major intermediate pressure boosting facility lifting treated water from Parvati & Warje WTPs to elevated hilltop reservoirs across Kothrud and Chaturshringi hills.
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.address: 32, Karve Road, Kachare Colony, Deccan Gymkhana / Erandwane

major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.name: Chaturshringi Water Reservoir & Pumping Office
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.function: High-elevation water storage and gravity distribution balancing reservoir feeding Model Colony, Shivajinagar, Senapati Bapat Road, Gokhalenagar, and Pune University.
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.address: Ganeshwadi, Near Ferguson College Road & Senapati Bapat Road, Shivajinagar

major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.name: Padmavati Water Pumping Station & Booster Reservoir
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.function: Supplying treated drinking water from Parvati HLR/LLR to Southern Pune elevated sectors, Bibwewadi, Upper Indiranagar, and Sahakarnagar.
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.address: Near Swami Vivekanand Putala, Pune-Satara Road, Padmavati

major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.name: Ramtekdi Water Supply Master Reservoir & Booster Station
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.function: Key hilltop balancing reservoir receiving treated water from Cantonment Water Works to feed Hadapsar, Magarpatta, Mundhwa, and Solapur Road suburbs.
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.address: JJC Colony, Ramtekadi Industrial Hilltop, Hadapsar

major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.name: Katraj Water Booster Pumping Station & Reservoir
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.function: Water booster station serving Katraj gaothan, Rajas Society, Katraj-Kondhwa road, and fringe hill settlements.
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.address: Near Rajiv Gandhi Zoological Park, Katraj

major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.name: Taljai Hill Water Storage Reservoir
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.function: High-gravity storage reservoir stabilizing water distribution pressures for Sahakarnagar and Dhankawadi wards.
major_pumping_stations_and_balancing_res.address: Taljai Hills Forest Park, Sahakarnagar / Dhankawadi

zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.name: Ghole Road - Shivajinagar Water Supply Division
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.responsibilities: Supervising water pipeline maintenance, valve operations, leakage repairs, and free municipal water tanker dispatches for Shivajinagar.
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.address: 1187/5, Ghole Road, Main Ward Office Building, Shivajinagar

zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.name: Aundh - Baner - Pashan Water Supply Division
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.responsibilities: Water distribution network monitoring, pressure regulation, and leak detection for Aundh, Baner, Balewadi, and Pashan.
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.address: Bremen Chowk, Near Ambedkar Chowk, Aundh

zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.name: Kothrud - Bavdhan Water Supply Division
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.responsibilities: Drinking water pipeline network upkeep, booster pump management, and tanker coordination for Kothrud and Bavdhan.
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.address: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Smarak, Paud Road, Kothrud

zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.name: Sinhgad Road - Vadgaon Water Supply Division
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.responsibilities: Managing water distribution along Sinhgad Road, Hingne, Vadgaon Budruk, Dhayari, and coordinating with Parvati/Vadgaon WTPs.
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.address: Near Dandekar Bridge, PL Deshpande Garden Road, Sinhgad Road

zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.name: Kasba - Vishrambaug Wada Water Supply Division
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.responsibilities: Operating old city valve systems, heritage area water supply grids, and high-density peth water pressure balancing.

zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.name: Bhavani Peth Water Supply Division
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.responsibilities: Managing water distribution in Bhavani Peth, Nana Peth, timber market, and commercial wholesale zones.
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.address: General Arunkumar Vaidya Stadium, Bhavani Peth

zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.name: Hadapsar - Mundhwa Water Supply Division
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.responsibilities: Regulating water supply in Eastern Pune, Ramtekdi reservoir supplies, Magarpatta, and municipal water tanker logistics.
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.address: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Road, Gadital, Hadapsar

zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.name: Yerwada - Kalas - Dhanori Water Supply Division
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.responsibilities: Water supply oversight for Yerwada, Shastri Nagar, Vishrantwadi, Kalas, and Dhanori.
zonal_water_supply_maintenance_offices.address: Near Gunjan Talkies, Airport Road, Yerawada
